Package index

Start a map

A map from data, which the layer functions add to with the pipe.

og_map()
A map: layers in groups, texts, base maps and palettes

Layers

A mark each, one row of the data to one mark: points, paths (rows joined in time), lines, segments, areas and text.

og_point() og_line() og_segment() og_polygon() og_text()
Points, lines, areas, segments and text
og_path()
Paths: rows joined in time, a line per group

The sea floor

A depth model’s depth in colour, its relief and its contours, made in the page from its tiles: an MBTiles file, a grid, or one named once by OGIS_DEPTH.

og_relief() og_contour()
The sea floor: depth in colour, its relief, and depth contours

Place names

A list of place names, each from its own zoom, found by the page’s Find box, what is known of each on a click; a table, a file, or one named once by OGIS_NAMES.

og_names()
Place names: labels, their areas, the Find box and what is known of each

Values by cell

A table of cells coloured by a value per square kilometre, such as fishing effort by gear and year, chosen in the page; a table, a Parquet file, or one named once by OGIS_CELLS.

og_cells()
Values by cell: fishing effort and the like, chosen by gear, year or any column

Vessel tracks

Pings as a track, a time panel of speed (a vessel, then a trip), lanes of what the vessel did, and the effort following the vessel chosen: a quick look at each step of a track’s processing.

og_tracks()
Vessel tracks: the track, a time panel of speed, trips, and the effort by cell

Time

A panel under the map: a group’s rows over time, linked to the map.

og_time()
A time panel under the map: one group's rows over time, linked to the map

In MapLibre’s own terms

A layer, its section and its tiles made by hand, for what the layer functions do not draw; added to the pipe by og_add_layer().

og_layer()
A layer of a map
og_add_layer()
A layer of your own on a map the pipe makes
og_section()
A group of layers in a map's sidebar
og_tiles_table()
A table of geometries as vector tiles
og_tiles_dem()
Tiles of elevations from a grid
og_tiles_mbtiles()
Tiles from an MBTiles file

Colours and base maps

og_palettes() og_basemaps()
The palettes and base maps of a map

A page of your own

A script of your own on the map, and routes of its own on the server: for a page that does more than show.

og_script()
A page's own script on a map

Show and share

A map served from R on this machine, or written as a folder that opens with no R.

print(<og_map>) format(<og_map>)
Show a map
og_serve() og_stop()
Serve a map
og_bundle()
Write a map as a folder that opens with no R and no server

What readers write

Notes and verdicts written on a served map, kept in a file beside it.

og_notes() og_notes_add()
Notes pinned on a served map
og_verdicts()
Verdicts given on a served map

Example data

og_example()
Read an example dataset shipped with ogis
dansk
Danish vessel tracks (AIS)
dansk_harbours
Harbour polygons for the Danish tracks
dansk_relief
Seabed and land elevation around the Danish tracks
trawlsurvey
Icelandic groundfish survey, March 2019, vessel tracks
trawlsurveytows
Icelandic groundfish survey, March 2019, tows
